description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS End User Messaging Social service, including method signatures for various WhatsApp messaging operations.

classes.name: SocialMessagingClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Social Messaging service, providing methods to manage WhatsApp messaging and account linking.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Associates a WhatsApp Business account with the user.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: deleteWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Deletes media related to WhatsApp messages.

methods.name: deleteWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: disassociateWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Disassociates a WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: disassociateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Retrieves details about linked WhatsApp Business accounts.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves linked WhatsApp Business account details.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumber
methods.description: Gets the phone number associated with a linked WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the phone number of linked WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Fetches media for WhatsApp messages.

methods.name: getWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: listLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccounts
methods.description: Lists linked WhatsApp Business accounts.

methods.name: listLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists linked WhatsApp accounts.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: postWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Uploads media for WhatsApp messages.

methods.name: postWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: putWhatsAppBusinessAccountEventDestinations
methods.description: Sets event destinations for WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: putWhatsAppBusinessAccountEventDestinationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets event destinations for WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: sendWhatsAppMessage
methods.description: Sends a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: sendWhatsAppMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
